verdict.rationale: Devin runs cloud sessions in their own VM that keep going after you close your laptop. Auto-Fix creates a closed loop that iterates on review comments and CI failures without you in the loop, and Devin can be wired into CI/CD pipelines and driven through the API to automate workflows. Its MCP server also exposes scheduling, and community reports confirm sessions run unattended for long stretches, with a configurable max work time. Missing for 10: dedicated documentation on how to configure scheduled or recurring automations and triggers (scheduling appears only as a passing MCP mention), and independent hands-on corroboration of scheduled or triggered automations specifically.
